notes.proxy: REF-basis masses; column counted as half (one arm)

extra.summary: Short 160 mm hollow dorsal column (z -222..-62, y -200..-100) on the rail pads/spine bridge, with a 186 mm PA-CF/Al outrigger beam carrying the S1 base on the old x -80 face; replaces the lateral plate + wing tongue and routes both arms' symmetric gravity moments into each other across the spine.
extra.column_length_reason: z -62 (just below C7/T1, keeps the cervical/neck keel clear and avoids the occiput) to -222; only ~160 mm of thoracic spine is bridged by a rigid part (upper thoracic segments move least, ribcage-stiffened; ROM figures UNSOURCED this session) - a full-height column would stiffen trunk flexion, so it is kept short.
contract_changes: Chassis plate + wing tongue (y -78..-46) deleted; the beam's Al seat plate keeps the x -80 rear face and the 4 x M5 pattern (y +-62, z -94/-68) but is 5 mm (was 8 mm) and 144 x 52 (was 158 x 100).
Clasp feet (bolt pairs on the plate front) lose their seats: need a new landing (beam front wall / column) - NOT designed.
Keel feet (2 x M4 at y +-50, z -109) land on the 62 mm tall channel, needs local solid bosses; spaulder rear feet (2 x M3 into the top edge) need solid lands in the 2.5 mm top wall.
Wing bolts and the wing tongue seat are gone; the wing (rail bridge) is replaced by the beam, so wing/spine-bridge interface re-drawn; left and right booms share one column.
decision_conflicts: No big backplate: pass (column 100 x 160 is a spine-bridge-sized member, not a backplate) but judge it against Forest's intent.
No hip belt: pass. Load path still shoulder clasp + paraspinal pads.
Trunk ROM: a rigid 160 mm member over T1-T8 adds some flexion stiffness (unquantified).
Nerve-sensitive spine: column bridges the spinous line with >= 10 mm gap (17.8 mm over the highest back point per row, skin gap reported in metrics); centre relief required.
Nothing rigid on moving skin: beam front is >= 22 mm off the back surface over the medial scapular border (-102 vs -124.6 max back x in y -100..76, z -116..-54): pass.

calcs.name: boom vertical bending + tip deflection
calcs.formula: M = W*L + M_S2cap ; delta = W L^3/(3 E I) + M_S2 L^2/(2 E I)

inputs.section: U-channel 17 x 62 x 2.5 PA-CF + 5 x 52 Al plate (modular ratio 11.5)

calcs.name: boom torsion (S2 cap about the beam axis y)
calcs.formula: J = 4 A^2 t / p ; tau = T/(2 A t) ; theta = T L/(G J)

calcs.name: column torsion, one arm vs two arms
calcs.formula: T_z = S1 cap reaction; mirrored arms: pseudovector components parallel to the mirror plane (M_x, M_z) cancel in the column, M_y (S2 reaction) adds

result.note: asymmetric (one arm moving) is the design case; gravity moment W*0.15 = 4.7 N.m cancels when both arms hang symmetric

calcs.name: load path
calcs.result: Column front face rides on the rail pads (y -138..-100 and mirror) so the vertical load enters the paraspinal strips (rail model 12.7 kPa at 5.79 kg/side) and the top pad (C7/T1 + clasp top facet) sees the same N_top = W of the harness model; the boom changes where the moment enters, not the sum of vertical loads. Added S2-pitch reaction (16.6 N.m both arms at cap) now goes into the column as a x-z bending couple: rail pads +/- 104 N over a 160 mm lever (rail pad row spacing 100 mm). The top-pad margin (2.0 %) is NOT improved: the column adds mass at the top.

printability.column: 190 x 100 x 14 hollow draped box prints in the 256 mm cube; lay it on its flat rear-ish side (x up) with layers along z, 2.5 mm walls = 6 perimeters, tree supports inside none needed if printed with the open ends sealed by caps
printability.beam: 186 x 62 x 17 channel: print on its front face (open side up, no supports), Al plate bolts on; PA-CF, annealed
